name: Optimiser
summary: Described by Microsoft on October 21: an agentic AI system Rolls-Royce uses to plan its engine shop visits, close to 1,500 in 2025. An Engine Agent draws on data about individual engines, a Workscope Agent helps determine what maintenance may be needed, Facility Agents weigh shop capacity and capability, and a Supplier Agent handles the supply chain, while people keep oversight. A planning exercise that took four or five people about a week has been materially reduced, and Rolls-Royce says it is helping reduce engine turnaround times. It is still developing.

whyItMatters: An engine in the shop is an aircraft not earning. Faster re-planning when a part slips or a slot opens means engines go back to airlines sooner. For Rolls-Royce customers the payoff is shorter shop visits; for your own planners, it is a model for splitting a planning job into agents with a person approving the result.
